import pytest
from roman import to_roman, from_roman


class TestToRoman:
    """Tests for to_roman(n)."""

    def test_zero(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            to_roman(0)

    def test_negative(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            to_roman(-1)

    def test_above_max(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            to_roman(4000)

    def test_bool_rejected(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            to_roman(True)

    def test_float_rejected(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            to_roman(3.14)

    def test_string_rejected(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            to_roman("1")

    def test_none_rejected(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            to_roman(None)

    # Boundary values
    def test_one(self):
        assert to_roman(1) == "I"

    def test_three(self):
        assert to_roman(3) == "III"

    def test_four(self):
        assert to_roman(4) == "IV"

    def test_five(self):
        assert to_roman(5) == "V"

    def test_nine(self):
        assert to_roman(9) == "IX"

    def test_ten(self):
        assert to_roman(10) == "X"

    def test_forty(self):
        assert to_roman(40) == "XL"

    def test_ninety(self):
        assert to_roman(90) == "XC"

    def test_hundred(self):
        assert to_roman(100) == "C"

    def test_four_hundred(self):
        assert to_roman(400) == "CD"

    def test_nine_hundred(self):
        assert to_roman(900) == "CM"

    def test_thousand(self):
        assert to_roman(1000) == "M"

    def test_two_thousand(self):
        assert to_roman(2000) == "MM"

    def test_three_thousand(self):
        assert to_roman(3000) == "MMM"

    def test_max(self):
        assert to_roman(3999) == "MMMCMXCIX"

    # Representative mid-range values
    def test_sample_values(self):
        assert to_roman(42) == "XLII"
        assert to_roman(1984) == "MCMLXXXIV"
        assert to_roman(2023) == "MMXXIII"


class TestFromRoman:
    """Tests for from_roman(s)."""

    def test_empty_string(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("")

    def test_non_string(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman(123)

    def test_none(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman(None)

    def test_float(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman(3.14)

    def test_list(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman(["I"])

    def test_lowercase(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("iv")

    def test_invalid_iiii(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("IIII")

    def test_invalid_vv(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("VV")

    def test_invalid_ic(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("IC")

    def test_invalid_xm(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("XM")

    def test_invalid_mmmm(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("MMMM")

    def test_banana(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("banana")

    def test_illegal_subtractions(self):
        """Test various illegal subtractive combinations."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("IL")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("IM")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("XD")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("VC")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("DM")

    def test_repeated_too_many(self):
        """Test repetitions beyond allowed count."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("IIII")  # I repeated 4 times
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("CCCC")  # C repeated 4 times
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("DD")    # D repeated 2 times
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("LL")    # L repeated 2 times
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("VV")    # V repeated 2 times

    def test_invalid_ordering(self):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("VX")
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            from_roman("XLIIII")

    # Valid round-trip values
    def test_valid_round_trips(self):
        assert from_roman("I") == 1
        assert from_roman("III") == 3
        assert from_roman("IV") == 4
        assert from_roman("V") == 5
        assert from_roman("IX") == 9
        assert from_roman("X") == 10
        assert from_roman("XL") == 40
        assert from_roman("XC") == 90
        assert from_roman("C") == 100
        assert from_roman("CD") == 400
        assert from_roman("CM") == 900
        assert from_roman("M") == 1000
        assert from_roman("MMMCMXCIX") == 3999

    def test_sample_valid(self):
        assert from_roman("XLII") == 42
        assert from_roman("MCMLXXXIV") == 1984
        assert from_roman("MMXXIII") == 2023


class TestRoundTrip:
    """Verify from_roman(to_roman(n)) == n for every n in range."""

    def test_all_values(self):
        for n in range(1, 4000):
            assert from_roman(to_roman(n)) == n, f"Failed for {n}"
